title: Metal Banging
blurb: Repeated hammering on metal, forty unbroken seconds of it, which turns out to be far more useful than it sounds. Long clips are the ones editors actually want: you can trim to any length, loop them under a scene, or ride the tail out at the end. The clanging reads industrial by default — scrapyards, engine rooms, something being repaired badly. Slow it down or add reverb and it turns threatening instead. Horror creators use it as off-screen activity, something large working away where you cannot see it.
origin: An extended recording of metal being struck repeatedly.
